quote: Most of the time, the pit crew changes the tires exactly as the fans at their track demanded. But occasionally, you get a 'Faithless Elector.' This is a rogue tire-changer who decides, right in the middle of a four-tire stop, to slap a Goodyear on a car that was supposed to get Firestones, effectively handing a Championship Lap to a driver who wasn't even in the lead pack.
